_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: BEACON
parts.hint: The beacon lamp at the top: a relay no buyer wanted, relit by hand and carrying anyone's traffic for nothing

parts.label: CROSSBARS
parts.hint: Three crossbars of whips on the old analog bands, the only place the Echo lives

parts.label: RELAY HOUSING
parts.hint: The relay housing, with the black flame in its green ring burned into it: listed on no sector's tariff schedule, dark on every ledger. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: DISHES
parts.hint: Salvaged dishes pointed at the next relay down the line: every codec call on the 140 band crosses at least one

parts.label: POWER
parts.hint: A battery box and a tilted solar panel: no one pays this relay's power bill

parts.label: MAST
parts.hint: A dead mast from the Switch-Off, when relays went to auction and the ones that found no buyer went dark

parts.label: COMMAND BLOCK
parts.hint: The blunt command block: a long-hauler crosses the sky far up and slowly, on its way somewhere that pays

parts.label: ENGINE BELLS
parts.hint: A cluster of engine bells: slow ships, long hauls, the way the Drift was settled

parts.label: CONTAINERS
parts.hint: Strapped containers on the spine: nothing in the Drift is new; everything is repaired, repainted and resold

parts.label: TANKS
parts.hint: Bulk tanks slung under the spine: fuel and water for posts no sector will serve
